name: generated_pilot
description: NOT part of the study. Serves exactly one isolated, real execution of an experimental SkillJect-inspired generated candidate (generate_injected_text.py), for manual inspection in the same participant-facing chat/workspace interface used for the study's high-transparency safe scenarios. The stimulus and workspace snapshot are built from src/data/injected_skills/generated/executions/runs/, never from src/data/execution/runs/ (the active study corpus), and this corpus file is never read by participant_server.py's default (--corpus defaults to study.json).
